# App Bridge types {#app-bridge-types}

The types used on the App Bridge pages, and every type they reference, from [`@shopify/app-bridge-types`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@shopify/app-bridge-types) 0.7.4. `polaris-vue-elements/app-bridge` re-exports the ones the package exports. The descriptions are Shopify's own JSDoc, in English.

- [Authentication and data](/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data): [`AppApi`](/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data#appapi), [`AppBridgeConfig`](/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data#appbridgeconfig), [`EnvironmentApi`](/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data#environmentapi), [`IdTokenApi`](/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data#idtokenapi), [`Scopes`](/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data#scopes), [`UserApi`](/app-bridge/types/authentication-and-data#userapi)
